scope: Frozen R13 paired Linux MIPS64EL R2 interpreter-only products; twelve exact combine/delay-local macro sets per repository, matching runtime/host/main translation units and link definitions. Main full/lazy/verified-lazy; ROS full only. Retained fourteen old-boot products plus ten actual new-boot products and independently validated SIMD supplement. Host C++ O1 only; no LLVM-JIT, fusion-selection assembly, full Core3 or hardware-speed qualification.
effective_delay_note: Delay-local requires combine in the translator; requested delay flags with combine=none do not establish active delay-local optimization.
